payload.summary: Playwright: one hydration test still waits on networkidle, which Playwright advises against
payload.detail: CORRECTED 2026-09-27 (Codex review on PR 3128): only one executable networkidle wait remains, tests/ui-hydration.spec.ts:61 await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle"). The other four originally cited lines (ui-specifiers.spec.ts:24, ui-style-contract.spec.ts:165, 184, 227) are comments recording that networkidle was deliberately avoided, so they need no change. Next action: replace the one call with a wait on the specific hydrated element or state the test needs.
